query: SELECT u.display_name, p.title, p.score, 'asked' AS involvement FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id WHERE p.post_type_id = 1 UNION SELECT u.display_name, p.title, p.score, 'answered' A
SELECT p.post_type_id, MIN(v.vote_type_id) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY p.post_type_id ORDER BY MIN(v.vote_type_id) DESC
SELECT u.location, COUNT(p.answer_count) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY u.location ORDER BY COUNT(p.answer_count) DESC
SELECT u.location, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS users, AVG(p.score) AS avg_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.location HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) > 50 ORDER BY avg_score
SELECT display_name, (SELECT MAX(view_count) FROM posts WHERE owner_user_id = users.id) as max_views FROM users WHERE reputation > 200
SELECT p.post_type_id, COUNT(v.vote_type_id) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY p.post_type_id ORDER BY COUNT(v.vote_type_id) DESC
SELECT u.location, MIN(v.vote_type_id) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY u.location ORDER BY MIN(v.vote_type_id) DESC
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY LOWER(display_name) ASC
SELECT u.location, COUNT(*) AS count, 'users' AS type FROM users u WHERE u.location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.location UNION ALL SELECT u.location, COUNT(p.id), 'posts' AS type FROM users u JOIN posts p
SELECT u.display_name, MIN(v.vote_type_id) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY u.display_name ORDER BY MIN(v.vote_type_id) DESC
SELECT display_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE owner_user_id = users.id) as post_count FROM users WHERE reputation > 500
SELECT DISTINCT u.display_name FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id
SELECT u.location, AVG(p.score) AS result FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY u.location ORDER BY result DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY LOWER(display_name) ASC
SELECT u.location, AVG(p.answer_count) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY u.location ORDER BY AVG(p.answer_count) DESC
SELECT u.display_name, SUM(p.score) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY u.display_name ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC
